text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen draws near. King Halo asks 
Seiun Sky how she can deliver results 
without being rattled by the spotlight.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
All she wanted was to win. Seiun Sky's 
words—"Mastering the unorthodox turns it 
into the royal road"—lit a fierce fire 
within King Halo.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the same day, she met another member of 
her generation, Grass Wonder. Returning 
from injury, she appeared to be in peak 
condition.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though she tried to catch them off guard 
with sweet talk, it didn't work. It seemed 
winning the Arima Kinen wouldn't come 
easily.
